name: rwa-token-pre-tge
description: PRE-TGE platform token, redeemable Product RWA, compliance-gated RWA Series units and fully-funded Merkle distribution vault; no automatic deployment

scripts.compile: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && solcjs --base-path . --include-path node_modules --abi --bin contracts/RWAToken.sol contracts/RWAVestingVault.sol contracts/ProductInventoryGate.sol contracts/ProductRWA1155.sol contracts/RedemptionManager.sol contracts/RWASeriesRegistry.sol contracts/RWASeriesUnits1155.sol contracts/RWADistributionVault.sol contracts/interfaces/*.sol -o build
scripts.test: node test/contracts.test.mjs && node test/product-rwa.test.mjs && node test/rwa-operating.test.mjs
